capabilities: Set static or animated wallpapers (.jpg, .png, .gif, .mp4, .webm, .avif) behind the workspace
Schedule wallpaper changes by time of day, weekday, or auto-rotate interval
Adjust size, position, opacity, blur, brightness, and contrast of backgrounds
Override CSS variables and selectors to make panels transparent
Switch back to previously used wallpapers via wallpaper history
extras: Warns that migration to a new wallpapers folder may have removed unused files from the old folder, and that the built-in CSS editor was removed in favor of the snippet method. Dark theme is recommended; advanced transparency requires CSS knowledge.
problem: Obsidian's appearance options only cover themes and CSS snippets and provide no way to place an animated or video background behind the interface.

relations.evidence: If you're looking for a graphical interface to tweak theme/plugin variables, try these community plugins

summary: Wallpaper plugin that sets animated or static image and video backgrounds behind the Obsidian workspace with scheduled rotation and visual effects.
